targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time, subject, observation FROM shared_observations WHERE observer='nova_ble_churn_report' AND observed_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY observed_at DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, 'named' AS metric, count(DISTINCT device_mac) AS value FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name != '' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, 'anonymous' AS metric, count(DISTINCT device_mac) AS value FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE (device_name IS NULL OR device_name = '') AND ts > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
